blurb: Matrice Jacobine is a French-language political and technology commentator who self-describes as a 'technoprogressive cosmist.' She posts about ethics in emerging technologies, political philosophy, and hacker culture. Her threads engage with left geopolitics — including detailed analysis of the Syrian revolution, Kurdish politics (PKK), and factional sectarianism — written primarily in French. She operates a secondary account under @MLaGrangienne.
credibility_note: Her Thread Reader App handle 'La Myasnikoviste ☭' signals an explicitly far-left, communist-adjacent political orientation, which likely frames her political philosophy content. Follower count and institutional affiliations are not available from the sources provided.
